name: vscode-tree
//: The tools that build and test the <vs-tree> custom element (README.md); the tree's own code is VS Code's source, pinned in MODULE.bazel. playwright is pinned to the version datalib/ui's lockfile resolves, so the facts test finds the browser the e2e suite already installed.

pnpm.//: No package's install scripts run: esbuild finds its binary in its platform package without its postinstall.
